_HOW_TO_APPLY: NON-DESTRUCTIVE. Do not overwrite data/schemas.json. Merge the single key
'kosha_entry' below into the existing top-level object in data/schemas.json,
and merge the 'kosha' block from kosha_taxonomy_ADDITION.json into
data/taxonomy.json (and its mirror data/_taxonomy.json). Everything the
importer writes lives under data/kosha/** only.

kosha_entry.description: One dictionary headword (kosha entry) from a lexicon such as Monier-Williams, Apte, Amarakosha, Shabdakalpadruma, Vacaspatyam, or a bilingual dict (sa-kn, sa-en, sa-bn, ...). Headwords are stored in Devanagari; headword_slp1 + fold power fuzzy cross-script lookup consistent with the app's SLP1 search spine. A headword may carry several senses, each glossed in its own language, so the same entry can serve cross-language pivot. Used for every folder under 'kosha'.

id.notes: SLP1 of the headword, made unique within the folder by suffixing a homonym index when needed (e.g. 'aMSu', 'aMSu~2').

headword.notes: The headword in Devanagari (the primary searchable text).

headword_slp1.notes: SLP1 canonicalization of the headword (exact, case-sensitive). Enables transliteration-agnostic lookup.

fold.notes: Phonetic fold of headword_slp1 (anusvara/nasal, s/sh/ss, vowel length, avagraha, gemination collapsed) -- the fuzzy match key, identical in spirit to the global search fold.

homonym.notes: 1-based homonym number when several distinct entries share one headword; omit if the only one.

headword_language.notes: ISO code of the headword's language; defaults to 'sa'. For a reverse dict (e.g. en-head) this is 'en', 'kn', etc.

source.notes: Slug of the source dictionary (matches the folder), e.g. 'mw-cologne', 'apte-1957', 'shabdArtha_kaustubha'. Redundant with the path but handy once entries are merged into the cross-dict index.

synonyms.notes: Alternate/inflected headword forms (Devanagari) from the StarDict .syn file or '|'-separated headword line.

synonyms_slp1.notes: SLP1 of each synonym, so they are all reachable by fuzzy lookup.

senses.notes: [{gloss, gloss_language, pos, etymology, note, citations}] -- gloss is the meaning text; gloss_language is its ISO code (e.g. 'kn','en','sa'); pos is part of speech / gender; etymology holds vyutpatti/nishpatti; note holds vistara/elaboration; citations is [{text, source}] of prayoga/ullekha quotations. The multi-language glosses across an aggregated headword are what the cross-language pivot renders.

author.notes: Override this folder's default_author for one entry, if ever needed.

references.notes: [{target, unit_id, note, type}] -- SAME shape as every other schema, plus an optional 'type' ('synonym_of' | 'see_also' | 'comments_on'). target is another folder slug (e.g. 'kosha/amarakosha'), unit_id the pointed-at item id. Powers the library-wide backlinks index.

tags.notes: free-form keywords for cross-library search -- independent of the taxonomy path.
